Name: A REAL DUNGEON
Author: ttt1303
Description:
[heading][b]✨ Key Features[/b][/heading]
[b]1. 15 Mythic Weapons with Unique Normal & Skill ([/b]
[code]R[/code][b]) Animations[/b]
Every weapon features custom pixel-art sprites, balanced progression stats, crafting recipes, Adventurer's Guild Shop availability, distinct normal-attack VFX/SFX, and a signature [b]Active Skill ([/b]
[code]R[/code][b]key)[/b] with magic rune circles, choreographed multi-layered effects, screen impact flashes, and unique sound effects:
[list]
[*][b]Gungnir[/b] — [i]Spear of Heaven[/i]: Piercing golden lance beam followed by 4 sky thunderbolts.[/*]
[*][b]Blades of Chaos[/b] — [i]Cyclone of Chaos[/i]: 3-beat 360° fiery chain whirlwind.[/*]
[*][b]Ruyi Jingu Bang[/b] — [i]Nhu Y Bien Truong[/i]: Extends smoothly up to 480px with golden rings and finishes with a massive shockwave slam.[/*]
[*][b]Cursed Blade Muramasa[/b] — [i]Crimson Bloodlust[/i]: 6-hit rapid crimson-violet Iaido blitz that restores HP.[/*]
[*][b]Dragonslayer[/b] — [i]Berserker's Earthshatter[/i]: Colossal iron slam unleashing 4 shockwave rings and 7 erupting earth spikes.[/*]
[*][b]Mjolnir[/b] — [i]Bifrost Thunderstrike[/i]: Electric rune circle calling down 6 sequential sky lightning bolts.[/*]
[*][b]Excalibur[/b] — [i]Promised Victory[/i]: Radiant golden magic circle, towering holy pillar of light, and 7 expanding halo rings.[/*]
[*][b]Frostmourne[/b] — [i]Wrath of the Lich King[/i]: Glacial rune nova summoning 9 erupting ice pillars in a frost cone.[/*]
[*][b]Moonveil[/b] — [i]Transient Moonlight[/i]: 3-phase starlight crescent moonbeam barrage.[/*]
[*][b]The Crucible[/b] — [i]Argent Annihilation[/i]: Argent plasma rune circle and 4-layer colossal cleave.[/*]
[*][b]Master Sword[/b] — [i]Blade of Evil's Bane[/i]: Sacred light wave plus a bonus holy beam and heal when at 75%+ HP.[/*]
[*][b]Ea, Sword of Rupture (Enuma Elish)[/b] — [i]Enuma Elish[/i]: 5 Golden Gate portals behind you unleashing a colossal crimson-gold spatial rupture beam.[/*]
[*][b]Tensa Zangetsu[/b] — [i]Getsuga Tenshou[/i]: Triple-layered black-crimson crescent wave with dark lightning.[/*]
[*][b]Void Reaper Scythe[/b] — [i]Reaper's Soul Harvest[/i]: Double 360° void sweep that drains life force from all nearby enemies.[/*]
[*][b]Zenith[/b] — [i]Zenith Convergence[/i]: Prismatic rune circle summoning 14 swirling rainbow phantom blades.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]2. 5 Custom Guild Companion NPCs[/b]
Meet [b]Kael[/b] (Swordsman), [b]Lyra[/b] (Cleric), [b]Vesper[/b] (Assassin), [b]Ignis[/b] (Pyromancer), and [b]Garrick[/b] (Vanguard):
[list]
[*]Authentic Stardew Valley-style character sprites, portraits, custom dialogue, gift tastes, and unique daily schedules.[/*]
[*][b]Adventurer's Guild Unlocked All Day:[/b] The Adventurer's Guild door is open from [b]6:00 AM to 2:00 AM[/b], and all 5 companions start inside the main hall every morning so you can easily meet and recruit them anytime![/*]
[*][b]Max 1 Active Companion:[/b] Press
[code]G[/code]near a companion (with a [i]Mercenary Guild Crest[/i] or Guild contract) to recruit or dismiss them.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Companion AI & Warping:[/b] Companions automatically teleport with you through mine exits and map warps, and each uses a balanced signature skill in combat (heal aura, meteor flare, cross slash, phantom execution, earthshaker).[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]3. Adventurer's Guild Rank & Daily Bounties ([/b]
[code]K[/code][b]Key)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Top-Left Guild Card HUD:[/b] Clean RPG-style card showing your current Guild Rank ([b]F → E → D → C → B → A → S → SSS[/b]), EXP bar, daily bounty progress, and active companion.[/*]
[*]Press
[code]K[/code]to open the Guild & Bounty Menu, claim rewards, and gain permanent Rank passive bonuses (damage & skill cooldown reduction).[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]4. 10 Dungeon Elites & 4 Raid Bosses[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom elite monsters and 4 Raid Bosses ([i]Arthas, Frost Sovereign[/i], [i]Blood Shogun Masamune[/i], [i]Ignis-Vorn, Hellfire Titan[/i], and [i]Gilgamesh, Celestial Monarch[/i]) spawn inside valid Mine floors (Floor 40+) and Skull Cavern.[/*]
[*]Safe floors, fishing floors (20, 60, 100), Floor 120, and the Quarry Mine remain completely safe.[/*]
[*]Defeat them to earn [b]Abyssal Monster Cores[/b], [b]Sovereign Boss Souls[/b], and the [b]Crown of the Abyssal Monarch[/b] for high-tier crafting.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]🎮 Controls[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][code]R[/code]— Activate equipped Mythic Weapon Skill[/*]
[*][code]K[/code]— Open Adventurer's Guild & Bounty Menu[/*]
[*][code]G[/code]— Recruit / Dismiss Companion NPC[/*]
[/list][i](Keybinds can be customized in [/i]
[code]MythicWeaponsCode/config.json[/code][i])[/i]
[line]
[heading][b]📦 Requirements[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher 2.0+[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]🛠️ Installation[/b][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract the archive.[/*]
[*]Copy
[code]MythicWeaponsCode[/code]and
[code][CP] MythicWeapons[/code]into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/*]
[/list]
